item.title: Elektor IoT sensor systems webinar links BeagleBoard and sensors
item.summary: Elektor will host a live webinar on practical IoT sensor systems on Thursday, 27 August 2026, bringing together modular sensor hardware, embedded processing, connectivity and Linux integration. Andrei Aldea of Texas Instruments will join Elektor host Brian Tristam Williams for the session, which begins at 16:00 CEST (14:00 UTC, 09:00 CDT and 10:00 EDT).
